title: How Long Dose a Mini Facelift Last?

html:
Let’s face it; no one’s face is the same, which means the results of a mini facelift can vary as well. With a decorated and skilled plastic surgeon like Dr. Micheal Hanemann of Hanemann Plastic Surgery, and by implementing a lifestyle that is as healthy as possible, you can enjoy a younger look from plastic surgery for many years to come.
What Contributes to How Long a Mini Facelift Lasts?
The duration of this procedure depends on several different factors, including age and the condition of a patient’s skin. Usually, patients who are less than 60 years old keep results the longest, but an experienced surgeon can provide lasting results for any age. Also, thin, fair, or sun-damaged skin doesn’t respond as well to treatment as healthy, darker skin does.
How long a mini facelift lasts depends on the talent of the plastic surgeon and the kind of facelift that gets performed. Invasive treatments require a longer recovery time, but most times their results last longer. Dr. Hanemann is an authority in plastic surgery and will complete methods to ensure you get a mini facelift that will last as long as possible.
Why Choose to Have a Mini Facelift?
If you have sagging jowls or wrinkles, S-lifts or mini facelifts target those areas and tighten the skin. Many younger patients choose S-lifts if they show signs of premature aging. A mini facelift is not as invasive as a full facelift and results last up to about five years. You can expect to look nearly 10 years younger than your actual age, despite the natural continuing of aging that follows treatment.
How Do You Keep Your Results for a Long Time?
Keep in mind that skin type and genetics can affect how long the results of a mini facelift lasts. Care doesn’t end after the plastic surgeon finishes; proper maintenance in-office and at home can help to ensure you have long-lasting results. In addition to the post-surgery suggestions from our surgeon, also consider some of the following tips:
• Avoid smoking because it impedes blood circulation and speeds up the aging process. It could cause scarring and premature wrinkling.
• Always wear sunscreen for the best protection and preservation.
• During recovery especially, limit the amount of alcohol you consume because it causes skin dehydration, which reduces the time you have to enjoy results.
• Drink plenty of water to remain hydrated and maintain your healthy skin.
• Keep a healthy weight and try not to fluctuate in weight to maintain elasticity so you keep looking vibrant and young.
• Follow any synergistic recommendations for post-facelift guidelines from our medical esthetician.
If you want professional and confidential care that can improve your appearance and boost your self-confidence, Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge is the place to go. Contact us today to schedule your consultation!
